id: title:eli-r-ph:stop a team purge between batches once its deletion is cancelled

review.posthog_relevance: Adds cancellation support to batch deletion workflows for teams and group mappings, allowing the deletion worker to stop processing batches upon receiving a cancellation signal, thereby preventing unnecessary RPC calls and resource consumption after cancellation.
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F1.H3 demonstrates the implementation of a cancellation check (`should_stop`) within batch deletion functions for teams and group mappings. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in reliability and resource efficiency by allowing the worker to halt processing mid-batch rather than completing unnecessary work.
